rows.source: the module's own DDM thresholds for this optic: high_warning 80, high_alarm 85, low_warning -10, low_alarm -15 (GSS-MPO250-SRC, read 2026-09-23). Another optic publishes its own numbers, so a cage with a different part needs its own row.
the module's own DDM thresholds for this optic: low_alarm 3.10, high_alarm 3.50 (read 2026-09-23)

3 is the value the module reports while locked to the grandmaster (observed on the lab module, streams flowing). Any other value is not locked; the manual's meaning for each code is not in the REST API, so no code is given its own severity here.
